payload.description_html: Dinevenator is a derived troodontid dinosaur notable for being relatively robust in terms of its paravian relatives. Like all troodontids, it was covered in feathers, and had a sickle-shaped toe claw on each foot, similar to the one seen in dromaeosaurs. Dinevenator was a small dinosaur, at about 2 m in total body length.
